registered_before: generation of the eight inputs and any native/Android output for this set
calibration_exclusion: All previously viewed eight-scene inputs, all earlier phases/crops and stripes/45deg checks are calibration; none is independent holdout.

frozen_parameters.sheet_note: Freeze existing shader clamping and all colors/compositing; style values are not a measurement of native optics.

world.encoding: 8-bit RGB PNG, opaque, embedded sRGB ICC, exact original bytes shared

frequency_coverage: Nonperiodic horizontal steps with unequal widths: vertical-normal excitation missing in old vertical stripes.
+31deg and -47deg diagonal log chirps, periods 96..3pt; independent phases.
Checker zones at 3,7,19,53pt cell widths with nonlegacy offsets.
Low-contrast weave: periods 11.3,23.7,67.1pt, small chroma and luminance differences.
Off-center light/dark Gaussian spots, scales 7..95pt, including oblique edge support.
Broad nonseparable chroma gradients, scale about 90..300pt.
Seeded band-limited texture: wavelengths 4..120pt and six independent orientations.

capture_contract.shared_input: Verify byte SHA256 before rendering on both platforms; export native original PNG bytes unchanged.
capture_contract.geometry: 375x667 source at world origin0,0; native iOS26.5 SE3 375x667pt at 2px/pt. Android predeclared wm size750x1334 and density320:375x667dp at 2px/dp. Record actual density/origin; no output-driven registration or scale fitting.
capture_contract.android_restore: In a finally block restore wm size with reset and density476; this capture-only override must not remain on the user device.
capture_contract.trace: Retain session, native effective material theme, window/canvas/control rectangles and per-capture AX.
capture_contract.no_motion_claim: REST only; no inference about held/moving control dynamics.
capture_contract.validity: Reject missing scenes, input mismatch, unfinished capture, wrong geometry, or interventions that change product parameters.

analysis_preregistration.units: Pair each candidate/native/baseline by input id, requested theme, effective material state, surface, probe and depth band.
primary_metrics: edge-normal curves and native contrast/texture attenuation
input-dependent visible edge/step loci when excitation is sufficient
analysis_preregistration.aggregation: Report every scene/probe/layer and candidate-minus-baseline change. No single global score can hide a direction/theme/input failure.
analysis_preregistration.sensitivity_rule: Keep observed pixels fixed when shifting the nominal contour. Report independent/native-vs-Android placement uncertainty; do not optimize alignment.
analysis_preregistration.uncertainty: Two actual REST repeats describe capture variability only, not independent statistical samples. Pixels are spatially correlated; do not invent pixel-count confidence intervals.
analysis_preregistration.material_mismatch: Retain mismatches as product behavior and separate their photometric effect from refraction claims; do not force native material to match Android.
analysis_preregistration.unidentifiable: Flat or weak/periodic input regions may not identify displacement. Mark insufficient excitation rather than scoring a pass.
analysis_preregistration.decision_1_absolute_native_alignment: Report all fixed-cell luminance/DeltaE2000, contour and identifiable transfer residuals with repeat and geometry sensitivity. No single similarity percentage or default absolute pass; retain unmet alignment and missing coverage explicitly.
analysis_preregistration.decision_2_relative_to_baseline: Report every scene/role/requested and effective theme/probe/depth cell and candidate-minus-baseline residual. Do not select favorable scenes or average away regressions.
review_flags: candidate worsens median or P95 DeltaE2000 by >1.0 and >10% in a fixed layer/probe, beyond REST repeat and geometry sensitivity
candidate increases linear-luminance MAE by >0.01 and >10% in a fixed layer/probe, beyond REST repeat and geometry sensitivity
candidate increases an identifiable source-step/edge-locus error by >0.5pt beyond geometric sensitivity
new cap islands, vanished transitions, direction asymmetry or high-frequency aliases absent in native
analysis_preregistration.threshold_scope: Flags are preregistered engineering review triggers, not claims of universal perception thresholds or 99.99% parity.
analysis_preregistration.coverage_limit: Eight synthetic backgrounds only. No extrapolation to all photos, controls, sizes or dynamic states. Real scenes, motion/acceleration/overshoot and a size family remain unvalidated.
analysis_preregistration.freeze_rule: No parameter changes after viewing this set. Any used-to-tune scene becomes calibration, all failures stay in report, and subsequent validation requires another registered unseen set.
